title: Sites
subtitle: Worksites, geofence configuration, and kiosk policy for your organization.

breakRoundingMode.full_hour: Rounds up to a full hour

noSiteRadius.title: No-Site Clock-In Radius
noSiteRadius.hint: When an employee clocks in without a registered site, their own clock-in point becomes the center of this range for the rest of that shift - the same protection a real site's geofence already gives, applied org-wide.
noSiteRadius.invalidRadius: Enter a radius greater than zero.
noSiteRadius.genericError: Unable to update the no-site radius.

form.displayAddressHint: Informational only - GPS coordinates and radius below are the real source of truth for geofence validation.
form.testLocationResultWithin: Your current location is {{distance}} m from this site's center - within the configured geofence ({{radius}} m).
form.testLocationResultOutside: Your current location is {{distance}} m from this site's center - outside the configured geofence ({{radius}} m).
form.timezoneHint: IANA time zone identifier, e.g. Africa/Cairo. Storage remains UTC; this only affects local display.
form.shiftPolicyHint: Optional - a site with none of these set behaves exactly as before. All times are in this site's own time zone.
form.blockSelfClockInLabel: Block self clock-in past the grace period (require a manager-assisted clock-in instead)
form.blockSelfClockOutLabel: Block self clock-out outside this site's work area (require a manager-assisted clock-out instead)
form.exemptEmployeesHint: Employees added here skip both the after-grace clock-in block and the outside-geofence clock-out block for this site.
form.presenceMonitoringEnabledHint: Re-checks location periodically during a shift at this site, enables the SOS button, and reports if someone leaves the area after clocking in. Off by default.
form.sitePolicyMovedHint: GPS accuracy tolerance, grace period, shift policy and exempt employees are managed from Settings.

detail.assignmentsHint: Employees and managers assigned to this site.
detail.noAssignments: No one assigned to this site yet.

assignForm.title: Assign an employee to this site

detail.projectsHint: Projects at this site. Employees must be assigned to a project before they can select it during attendance.
detail.noProjects: No projects at this site yet.
detail.workforceHint: External contractor workers - not PROSM Time employees. Each gets a 6-digit number, which alone is used to clock in/out at this site's Kiosk (no photo, no separate PIN).
detail.noWorkforce: No workforce added at this site yet.
detail.workforceOverrideError: Unable to clock out this worker.

projectAssignments.title: Project assignments

projectAssignments.noAssignments: No one assigned to this project yet.
projectAssignments.genericError: Unable to update this project's assignments.
